# Installing bugfix-swarm on Claude Code

## What gets emitted

- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`

## Installing

Register the marketplace, then install the plugin.

From a shell:

```
claude plugin marketplace add taylorsatula/bugfix-swarm
```

```
claude plugin install bugfix-swarm@bugfix-swarm-dev
```

Or, inside a Claude Code session:

```
/plugin marketplace add taylorsatula/bugfix-swarm
```

```
/plugin install bugfix-swarm@bugfix-swarm-dev
```

If the marketplace is already registered, only the install command is needed. Consult Claude Code's plugin docs if these commands don't match your installed version.
